title: Palindromic Substrings
summary: Count how many contiguous substrings of a string are palindromes.

tests.explain: Only the three single letters are palindromes.
Six substrings: a (three times), aa (twice) and aaa.
a, b, b, a, then "bb" and "abba": 6.

hints: Substrings at different positions count separately even when their text is equal, so "aaa" has 6: three single letters, two "aa" and one "aaa".
Every palindrome has a center (a character, or the gap between two characters). Each palindrome is counted exactly once if you count it from its center.
For each of the 2n - 1 centers, expand outward while the two ends match, and add one to the count for every successful expansion step. The total is the answer.

complexity.time: O(n²): each center expands up to n / 2 steps
